description: Searches Hire Overseas's pool of remote professionals in the Philippines, Latin America and Africa for a role and returns up to 5 anonymized profiles in seconds. Profiles show first name, country, skills and experience; never a surname, contact detail or employer name. Each profile has a candidateRef that get_candidate_resume and request_intro accept, says whether a resume exists, and includes a link to the candidate's intro video when there is one.

description.description: What the person will do, tools they need, hours. More detail gives better matches.

minYearsExperience.description: Only return candidates with at least this many years of relevant experience, e.g. 3

regions.description: Limit to regions: ph (Philippines), latam (Latin America), africa. Omit for all.

name: search_candidates
title: Search overseas candidates
